guidance: Record architecture decisions with rationale. Name the source requirements; do not restate them. Follow Design & Architecture Principles. Do not expand this into an RFC or a restated PRD.

outline.title: Design Context
outline.guidance: Anchor the design to its source requirements, goals, and decisions. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Source Requirements
children.guidance: Name the exact upstream PRD or Change Request title this design implements. Do not restate its content.

children.title: Goals and Constraints
children.guidance: List the technical outcomes this design must achieve and the hard limits it must respect. Keep this to constraints, not a requirements dump.

children.title: Key Decisions
children.guidance: Follow Design & Architecture Principles for decision discipline. Record each chosen option with rationale; do not list undecided options as if they were chosen.

outline.title: Architecture
outline.guidance: Group the components that own this change. Follow Design & Architecture Principles for boundaries. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Component
children.guidance: Title each instance with the component name, not "Component".

children.title: Responsibility
children.guidance: State what this component owns and what it must not own. One owner per concern.

children.title: Interfaces
children.guidance: Name the APIs, events, or data stores this component exposes or consumes. Point to contract instances by name rather than duplicating schemas here.

outline.title: Contracts and Data
outline.guidance: Group the schemas and behaviours other systems depend on. Follow Design & Architecture Principles for compatibility. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Contract
children.guidance: Title each instance with the API, event, or schema name, not "Contract".

children.title: Schema and Behaviour
children.guidance: Describe the payload shape and the success and failure behaviour callers can rely on.

children.title: Validation and Compatibility
children.guidance: State how input is validated at this boundary and how the contract evolves without breaking existing callers.

outline.title: Operational Quality
outline.guidance: Cover security, reliability, and any migration needed to run this design. Follow Design & Architecture Principles. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Security and Privacy
children.guidance: Name auth, authorization, and data-handling requirements at the boundaries this design introduces. Do not invent threats you cannot justify.

children.title: Reliability and Observability
children.guidance: State failure modes, retries, and the signals that show this design is healthy or degraded.

children.title: Migration and Rollback
children.guidance: Describe data or traffic migration and how to revert if the change fails. Omit if no migration is needed.

outline.title: Verification
outline.guidance: Show how this design covers the source requirements and how it will be tested. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Requirement Traceability
children.guidance: Map each source requirement to the component or contract that satisfies it. Name gaps explicitly.

children.title: Test Approach
children.guidance: State the levels and critical paths that prove this design works. Do not write the full test plan here.
